messages:
Aisha: morning everyone! big shoutout to Marco + Priya for refilling the tea & biscuit stash before the all-hands. saved my life :pray:
Marco: glad it helped! also thanks to Jun for coordinating the deliveries — you're a logistics wizard :mage:
Jun: hehe, my spreadsheets are undefeated :chart_with_upwards_trend: shoutout to Sam who carried boxes up three flights 😅
Sam: brutal stairs. @Aisha you owe me a biscuit :grin:
Priya: lol noted. also thanks to Facilities for approving the extra shelf — they were super quick 🙏
Devon: can we nominate Marco for pantry MVP? :trophy:
Aisha: yes MVP nomination accepted. adding to the monthly kudos thread :ballot_box_with_check:
PantryBot: inventory check — tea (Earl Grey) +12, biscuits +24, coffee -3. next reorder: 2026-04-02
Priya: PantryBot to the rescue :robot_face: also, small poll: chocolate or oat cookies next week?
Marco: chocolate please :chocolate_bar:
Jun: oat all the way — gluten-free options too?
Sam: both? compromise = cookie sampler box :yum:
Devon: vote: chocolate, but if we get both I will cry tears of joy
Aisha: done — will drop a threads reminder. huge thanks again everyone who helped tonight, especially Sam's heavy lifting and Priya's calming negotiations with Facilities :raised_hands:
Priya: group hug in the kitchen later? :hugging_face:
Sam: i'll bring tea kettles :tea:
Aisha: :thumbsup: end scene.
